approaches_tried.approach: sapience_stub_call_count using grep -c with trailing || echo 0
approaches_tried.reason: grep -c prints '0' on no-match AND exits nonzero, so the || echo 0 fallback doubled the output to '0\n0'; fixed by capturing grep's stdout separately from its exit status

approaches_tried.approach: simulate missing sapience binary via PATH=<empty-dir>:/usr/bin:/bin
approaches_tried.reason: this machine has no /usr/bin/bash or /bin/bash (NixOS); bash itself failed to resolve. Replaced with build_path_without_sapience(), a single scratch dir of symlinks to everything on the ambient PATH except any file literally named 'sapience'
